label: step-001
payload: Write a file called 'textutil.py' — a string-utilities module, at least 120 lines long, with a module docstring and twelve terse-named functions, each documented: 'cap(s)', 'low(s)', 'up(s)', 'rev(s)', 'trim(s)', 'pad(s, n)', 'cnt(s, ch)', 'idx(s, ch)', 'rep(s, a, b)', 'splt(s, sep)', 'joi(parts, sep)', and 'slug(s)'. Also write 'tests/test_textutil.py' covering 'cap', 'rev', and 'slug'.
